title: Chapter 59 — Builder Programs and Volume Agreements
intro: Formalizing anchor relationships — program structures, tiers, and the agreement.

sections.title: Structure Creates Commitment
sections.content:
A handshake deal can disappear with one bad day. A formal program — with agreed pricing, service levels, and volume commitments — creates mutual accountability.

Builder programs typically include tiered pricing based on volume, priority delivery scheduling, dedicated support, and quarterly reviews.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating builder programs, ask:

Are top accounts operating under formal agreements — or informal arrangements?
Do programs include mutual commitments — not just discounts?
Are programs reviewed and updated regularly?
